arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/workspace/submission/planner.py'
s=open(p).read()
a=s.index('    def feasible(self, ratio):\n')
b=s.index('        net, source, sink, required = self.network(ratio, optimize=True)\n',a)
s=s[:a]+'''    def feasible(self, ratio):
        # This equivalent compressed network is used only for decisions.
        net, source, sink, required = self.network(ratio)
        return net.maxflow(source, sink, required) == required

    def coverage(self):
        ratios = sorted({Fraction(k, f[0]) for f in self.case['flows']
                         for k in range(f[0] + 1)})
        if self.feasible(ratios[-1]):
            return ratios[-1], None
        # Zero coverage is always feasible. Keep an adjacent feasible /
        # infeasible pair in the finite public ratio set.
        low, high = 0, len(ratios) - 1
        while high - low > 1:
            mid = (low + high) // 2
            if self.feasible(ratios[mid]):
                low = mid
            else:
                high = mid
        return ratios[low], ratios[high]

    def solve(self):
        ratio, next_ratio = self.coverage()
        if next_ratio is not None:
            # Compute this once on the full network so even redundant unit
            # pair-arc capacities are included in the reported cut inequality.
            cut = public_cut(self.case, self.passes, next_ratio)
            assert cut is not None
        else:
            cut = None
'''+s[b:]
s=s.replace("                'flow': flow, 'potential': potential, 'cut': cut}\n\n\n\n", "                'flow': flow, 'potential': potential, 'cut': cut}\n\n\n")
s=s.replace("    return [node for node in range(K) if reached[node]]\n\ndef plan", "    return [node for node in range(K) if reached[node]]\n\n\ndef plan")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
